answer: Cosignatures are collected in prism, verified in ripple, and whisper names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 16 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 270 aliases cost 39 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
